evals.prompt: 把 Oleander 的 Blender 场景交给 Unreal 做实时漫游，同时还要给 Illustrator 一张分层轴测爆炸图，请设计交换和检查流程。
evals.expected_output: A scale-safe exchange plan, format selection, model manifest, texture/camera rules, and axonometric output checklist.

evals.prompt: 检查一个 D5 渲染场景为什么换电脑后贴图丢失，并整理成可以归档的 Oleander 模型包。
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive dependency audit and relative-path archive structure with validation renders.

evals.prompt: 在 Blender 5.2 LTS 里做同一产品的五种 CMF 对比。要求结果可作为设计判断证据，但不能把 roughness、IOR 或 micro-normal 当成真实材料测量。
evals.expected_output: A controlled CMF comparison route that locks geometry, camera, light rig, color pipeline, render engine/device, identifies representation parameters, retains render/readback evidence, and leaves physical material truth outside the PASS.

evals.prompt: Blender 5.2 的 Online Asset Library 里用了一个 HDRI 和一个材质，离线交付时网络断开。判断能不能 Promotion，并给出修复路径。
evals.expected_output: FAIL/HOLD for network-only required dependencies; materialize recoverable assets where allowed, record source/library identity, create dependency manifest, reopen offline, and do not treat packing as ownership transfer or proof that every dependency is included.

evals.prompt: 用 Blender 5.2 Geometry Nodes 的 cloth dynamics 做软包产品压陷动画，并证明这个结构符合人体工学和量产要求。
evals.expected_output: Allow bounded visual/form exploration but reject promotion to ergonomic, engineering, or manufacturing truth; record solver/runtime/input/cache state and retain the evaluated carrier as derived evidence only.

evals.prompt: 一个 911 参考复现模型在最终 SubD 结果上已经很密，但 Source cage 很稀。审查者要求为了达到 vertex 数门槛继续给 Source 加点。
evals.expected_output: Separate Source control density from evaluated-surface sampling and design quality; measure the final evaluated carrier, avoid source densification unless representation causality requires it, and route remaining fidelity failure back to the semantic surface relation.

evals.prompt: 同一 Blender 文件一组图用 AgX，一组图用 ACES 2.0，然后直接比较哪个材质更高级。
evals.expected_output: Reject the comparison because the color pipeline drift invalidates causal material comparison; record working/display/view/output spaces and rerun under one locked pipeline unless color management itself is the test variable.

evals.prompt: 用户要 Blender 直接输出 STEP 给结构工程师。当前环境没有任何 STEP 插件，但项目技能里一般写了 STEP/IGES。
evals.expected_output: HOLD_IO_OPERATOR_UNAVAILABLE: verify an actual installed bridge/add-on or route through a CAD tool; do not infer native Blender STEP support from the generic pipeline format list; declare semantic loss and round-trip requirements.

evals.prompt: 为了让两版曲面差异更明显，一版 Cycles 关 denoise，另一版开强 denoise 并加 compositor glare。这样能不能作为 Surface PASS 证据？
evals.expected_output: Reject as uncontrolled diagnostic evidence; keep render engine, device, denoise/postprocess and color pipeline locked, and forbid post-processing that conceals or exaggerates the defect being judged.

evals.prompt: 把一个 Blender 4.5 LTS 的长期项目迁移到 5.2 LTS。文件能打开，是否可以直接覆盖旧文件并宣布迁移完成？
evals.expected_output: No. Preserve the last-known-good source, create a migration revision, read back geometry/modifiers/nodes/libraries/materials/color management/cameras/simulations/I-O, record version/runtime changes, and only pass the migration gate after semantic drift checks.

evals.prompt: 给车身开后窗的 Boolean modifier 返回成功，模型也还存在，faces 从 8637 变成 96。自动化脚本应该把这一步记成 PASS 吗？
evals.expected_output: No. Separate OPERATOR_APPLIED from HOST_PRESERVED; classify this as a catastrophic local-edit host-preservation failure, retain it as negative evidence, roll back to the LKG, and require task-specific before/after face/bounds/protected-region checks before any destructive edit can pass.

evals.prompt: 911 候选的 SIDE top silhouette RMSE 只有约 14mm，但 FRONT/REAR width-by-height profile 超门槛，3/4 实际预览也不像 992.2。SIDE 指标能不能证明 whole-form reference fidelity？
evals.expected_output: No. Carrier congruence is necessary but measurement coverage is still partial. Preserve the SIDE screen as a local PASS, keep FRONT/REAR and held-out 3/4 failures visible, and block whole-form/reference-fidelity promotion until the required dimensions, feature families, and held-out views are covered.

evals.prompt: 某个 Blender benchmark 脚本已经提交到 PR，整个 workflow 也是绿色，但 workflow 实际只调用了上一版脚本。能不能说新脚本已经通过 Blender runtime？
evals.expected_output: No. Require exact target invocation and revision-bound output readback. Script existence and workflow success are not target execution evidence; keep IMPLEMENTED, INVOKED, EXECUTED, RECEIPT_VALID, EXPERIMENT_RESULT, EVIDENCE_RESULT, and DESIGN_RESULT separate.

evals.prompt: 一个汽车复现候选把 REAR body-only RMSE 从 0.172 降到 0.077，SIDE/front regression locks 都 PASS，Source 仍 20 controls 且 0 folds；但 held-out rear 3/4 出现明显双脊和夹瘪，C-pillar→haunch 关系更不像参考。下一步应该继续调 rear taper 参数把 RMSE 做得更低吗？
evals.expected_output: No. Retain the numerical improvement as valid local evidence but REJECT the candidate for design/reference progression, keep the previous LKG, and reclassify relation ownership. The held-out failure indicates the taper is being solved in the wrong representation layer (e.g. greenhouse/C-pillar/aperture architecture versus generic primary-body rail shrink). Do not continue target-metric optimization until the owning relation/representation is corrected and then re-run both fitted and held-out gates.

evals.prompt: 一个 evaluated 车身 mesh 对曲面诊断已经足够密，但开后窗时发现 56 张 faces 横跨 rear-glass 的 canonical lateral boundary。可以直接按 face centroid 或 owner predicate 的 if/else 顺序，把整张 face 分给 rear 或 side 然后删除吗？
evals.expected_output: No. Surface sampling sufficiency does not imply semantic-boundary topology sufficiency. A primitive crossing the canonical owner boundary is not exclusive; classify it as boundary-straddling, block destructive edit, and split/partition Derived topology on the canonical boundary (or move the boundary upstream into generated construction) while keeping Source authority unchanged. Then rerun owner coverage, predicted preservation and post-edit host preservation before any design/reference claim.
